draft: In Mexico City, a toxic yellow haze blankets the sky, reminding residents of environmental collapse. Buildings sway during tremors and water shortages are common. People use sheltered transit tubes to avoid street gangs, while markets remain tense but functional. Mutual aid groups help each other through hardship as state surveillance and armed patrols control the city. Strikes and protests arise from discontent over creeping corporate control, but people hold on in hopes that things will eventually improve.
